title: Closeout Steps 5b/5c assume bytype/ directory structure — not present in flat-lug spokes
summary: Steps 5b (adoption marker sync) and 5c (lug status sync and index regeneration) scan bytype/*/open/ and bytype/*/completed/ directories. Flat-lug spokes use WAI-Lugs.jsonl only — no bytype/ dirs. Steps silently N/A every session without any capability check at the top of the procedure.
fix_suggestion: Add a capability check at the top of wai-closeout.md: if bytype/ does not exist, skip Steps 5b/5c and log 'flat-lug spoke — bytype steps skipped'. This makes the skip explicit rather than silent.
